properties.text: Coordinates know where. They do not know what.
What if software exposed meaning instead?
Stable refs. Typed operations. Explicit policy.
Drivers, OS semantics and MCP federation share the same authority.
Use the strongest semantic surface available.
Native API → semantic OS → input fallback → vision last
This film uses the same machinery.
No eval. No arbitrary npm. No blind pixel clicks.
